R3.t3_adjudication_2026_09_18: ALL 10 SURVIVING T3 RANK CLAIMS ADJUDICATED FALSE POSITIVE, AND T3 DELIBERATELY NOT WEAKENED. T3 exists to catch a rank claim that points at a rebate figure a reader cannot see -- 'the largest rebate' shipped live on six pages, and 'the second-largest cap in its residential program' and 'the larger of the two' are the recorded instances. None of the 10 does that: 'Is the rebate worth the paperwork on a smaller job?' ranks JOB SIZE; 'a blower door test costs a fraction of an insulation project' ranks COST against COST, which Ruling 2 carves out explicitly; 'the single biggest lever on the answer/result' ranks an INPUT'S INFLUENCE on a calculator output; 'the highest return per dollar spray foam offers' ranks a CONSTRUCTION MEASURE. T3 fires when a rank word co-occurs with a money OR PROGRAM word anywhere in the sentence, and 'rebate' is a program word, so any sentence mentioning a rebate near a comparative trips it. A narrowing was designed and REJECTED: requiring a money noun within a fixed window of the rank word clears these 10 but also clears 'the attic cap is the larger of the two', where the money noun sits outside a tight window and which is one of the actual defects this rule caught. Trading a live false-negative in the one rank class that has really shipped, for a lower count on a REPORT-ONLY rule that changes no exit code, is a bad trade. R3 is non-blocking by design and its 68.1% measured false-positive rate is the price of that; showing a human too much here is the rule working. Re-adjudicate these 10 rather than filtering them.
